study: Independent GenDivRange expected-heterozygosity contrasts, not old TTF COI/IBD transfer
claim: Historical climate magnitude was distinguishable from same-product present climate and geography on genetic population sites, but did not materially improve unseen-species He contrast predictions under the prospectively frozen one-extra-term model. Predictor information must not be reinterpreted as biological response relevance.
limitations: He within-study contrasts are not FST or geographic genetic discontinuity
Single 21ka-minus-0BP magnitude misses time trajectory and signed components
No post hoc subgroup or predictor selection authorized
All results observational; no causal historical-memory claim
stop_policy: Do not rerun the frozen genetic outcome to tune predictors, threshold, site subset or inclusion decisions. Additional independent registered study would be distinct program.
